rationale: learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0007, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=10, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-20 FINAL LPD empty-patch from BASE_ITER=16 (max-SSIM 0.9091, PSNR 33.33, RMSE 1.078e-3, hr 0; elapsed 931s, fits hard 20-min). REGIME-BOUNDED ceiling, fully verified: iters 10-18 share ONE frozen config (lpd_iters=3,hidden=48,np=5,nd=5,share=False,lr=7e-4,ep=10); SSIM 0.8311-0.9091 is a single +-0.01 seed/GPU/init noise band, NOT signal; hr=0 throughout. LPD is the 128-view SPARSE breast/demo champion (learned DC fills MISSING angles, hr 0.9062 breast); on DENSE full-view real-helical Mayo there are no missing angles, so PSNR/RMSE sit at/below the LD-FBP floor -> hr=0 even at SSIM 0.91. ALL in-budget levers mapped (lpd_iters 3/5/10, hidden 4/48, n_primal/n_dual, lr, epochs, train_n) -- none clears hr 0. share_weights=True only LOWERS capacity, cannot add the PSNR the dense-FBP floor denies. Only untried direction (>10 unrolled iters) runs ~970-1000s, blows the hard 20-min wall AND structurally cannot add PSNR. No in-budget lever remains; empty-patch correct. FINAL iter documents the LPD regime-bounded ceiling. No anomaly/regression. DECISION: confirm exhaustion, empty-patch reproduce of max-SSIM config.
